guides.title: How to Dress for Your Body Type
guides.excerpt: Learn which garment cuts, lapel widths, and fits flatter your specific physical build.
guides.content:
## Understanding Your Silhouette
Whether you are athletic, tall, slim, or stocky, dressing according to your body proportion instantly improves your appearance.

## Ectomorph / Slim Build
- Use layering to add structural bulk.
- Avoid ultra-skinny cuts that emphasize thinness.

## Endomorph / Broader Build
- Prioritize vertical lines and monochrome dark layers.
- Avoid wide horizontal stripes and baggy garments.
guides.seoDesc: Flattering clothing fits and cuts for every male body type.

guides.title: Easy Guide to Office & Smart Casual Wear
guides.excerpt: Learn how to dress smart and comfortable for office work and weekend outings.
guides.content: Smart casual is simple once you know the basics. Pair a crisp cotton button shirt or polo T-shirt with comfortable chino pants or dark blue jeans. Always match your brown belt with brown shoes, or black belt with black shoes for a neat look.
guides.seoDesc: Learn easy smart casual dress rules for work and weekends.

guides.title: Simple Color Matching Guide for Men
guides.excerpt: Learn how to match shirt, pants, and shoes colors effortlessly.
guides.content: Color matching is easy with basic neutral colors. Keep 60% of your outfit in easy base colors (Navy Blue, Dark Grey, Khaki), 30% in secondary shirt colors (Light Blue, White, Cream), and 10% in shoes and belt accents.
guides.seoDesc: Learn easy color matching rules for mens shirts, pants and shoes.

guides.title: Shoe & Belt Matching Rules
guides.excerpt: The simple rules for matching shoes, belts, and socks correctly.
guides.content: Matching your belt color to your shoe color is the most important rule. Dark brown shoes need a dark brown belt, black shoes need a black belt, and casual sneakers go well with casual cloth or braided belts.
guides.seoTitle: Shoe and Belt Matching Guide | StyleIQ
guides.seoDesc: Learn how to match leather shoes and belts correctly.

guides.title: Summer & Warm Weather Dressing Tips
guides.excerpt: Stay cool and smart with lightweight cotton, linen pants, and casual shirts.
guides.content: Beat the heat in style. Wear breathable fabrics like cotton and linen. Pair light green or cream linen pants with casual collar shirts and loafer shoes.
guides.seoDesc: Learn easy summer clothes matching tips.

styleRules.title: Always Leave the Bottom Button of a Suit Coat Open
styleRules.explanation: Suit coats are designed to fit properly when the bottom button is left unbuttoned. Buttoning it causes folds and restricts movement.

styleRules.title: Always match sock color to your trousers, not your shoes
styleRules.explanation: Matching socks to trousers visually elongates your legs, making you appear taller and seamless.

styleRules.title: Always Unbutton the Bottom Button of a Suit Jacket
styleRules.explanation: Suit jackets and waistcoats are cut to flare gracefully when the bottom button is left open. Fastening the bottom button distorts the garment shape.

styleRules.title: Anchor Colorful Outfits with Neutral Trousers
styleRules.explanation: When wearing a statement jacket or patterned shirt, use neutral navy, charcoal, or khaki trousers as a clean visual anchor.

styleRules.title: Avoid Short Socks with Tailored Dress Trousers
styleRules.explanation: Bare ankles or short athletic socks disrupt formal suit silhouettes. Wear over-the-calf or mid-calf dress socks in formal environments.

styleRules.title: Avoid Short Sports Socks with Formal Suit Pants
styleRules.explanation: Short ankle sports socks look out of place with formal suit pants. Wear formal socks that cover your calf for formal settings.

styleRules.title: Match Patterned Shirts with Plain Pants
styleRules.explanation: When wearing a check, line, or printed shirt, pair it with simple plain navy, grey, or khaki pants to keep your outfit looking neat and balanced.

styleRules.title: Match Tie Width to Coat Collar Width
styleRules.explanation: Slim collar coats look best with slim ties, while regular collar coats look best with classic width ties.

styleRules.title: Match Tie Width to Suit Lapel Width
styleRules.explanation: Slim lapels require a slim tie (2.75"), while classic wider lapels demand a classic tie (3.25"–3.5") for balanced proportion.

styleRules.title: Match your leather belt with your leather footwear
styleRules.explanation: If you wear dark brown leather shoes, your belt must be dark brown leather. Black shoes demand a black belt.

styleRules.title: Never button the bottom button of a suit jacket or cardigan
styleRules.explanation: Jackets are tailored to flare at the hip when the bottom button is left undone. Buttoning it causes pulling fabric lines.

styleRules.title: Never Match Black Shoes with a Brown Belt
styleRules.explanation: Mixing black leather dress shoes with a brown leather belt creates visual disunity. Always match the tone and finish of leather accessories.

styleRules.title: Never Wear a Brown Belt with Black Shoes
styleRules.explanation: Mixing black leather shoes with a brown leather belt looks odd and unmatched. Always match brown belt with brown shoes, and black belt with black shoes.

styleRules.title: Never Wear a Casual Collarless Shirt with a Tuxedo Coat
styleRules.explanation: Tuxedos are strictly formal and require a crisp formal dress shirt with formal cuffs.

styleRules.title: Never Wear Button-Down Collars with a Tuxedo
styleRules.explanation: Button-down collars are inherently casual. Formal tuxedo shirts require a wingtip or crisp spread collar with French cuffs.
